title: Parallel courses
pattern: BFS by layers on a DAG
statement: Courses are labelled 1…n; [a, b] means a must be taken before b. In one semester you may take any number of courses whose prerequisites are all done. Return the minimum number of semesters, or −1 if impossible.
hints: Kahn's algorithm, processed one layer at a time.
The answer is the length (in nodes) of the longest path in the DAG.

solution.explanation: Process Kahn's frontier in layers, like level-order BFS: each layer is one semester. The number of layers equals the longest path in the DAG, which is the critical path, the same quantity that bounds a parallel build or a GPU kernel's dependency chain.
